headline: North Georgia unbeaten with seven scorers and one goal conceded
dek: North Georgia have won three and drawn one, and have conceded a single goal across those matches. Seven different players have scored their eight goals. Clayton State are the only other side yet to lose.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: North Georgia's eight goals have come from seven different scorers; the spread, not the total, is what separates them from the rest.

wire.line: Lander are the only programme still without a goal.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches have passed their date with no published result, and there are no score gaps.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Clayton State have won two and drawn one, scoring seven and conceding two.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lander have drawn one and lost one without scoring, and have no scorer to name.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Miguel Pineda has made seven saves for North Georgia without conceding.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Theo Hoang has scored four of Georgia Southwestern's six goals from seven shots.

last_match.line: North Georgia remain unbeaten and have kept another clean sheet.

next_match.line: Clayton State are unbeaten; Florida Tech held North Georgia to a goalless draw this week.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
